lines: @jgoetzmann-bot review copilots work when its done. This is not blocked by v0.2.0

37.question: Issue #37 (patch v0.2.1) says it should only be built once Classic+ ships, and Classic+ hasn't shipped: the catalog is still the 111 Core cards and patch v0.2.0 (Classic, Classic+, the Activate and Upgrade keywords, the Fruit pool with its Grapes) is only a design brief in docs/classic-sets.md. Should the bot (a) wait until v0.2.0 is merged and pick this up then, (b) build only the cosmetic items now (keywords in the deckbuilder, the locked-zone icon and its blocked X, the defense-position and mulligan animations bleeding into the next turn, scrolling through related cards), or (c) build the whole patch now on the existing Heroic Power code, with Pluck and KY Brainstorm drawing only from Core's pools?

44.question: Issue #44 depends on #40 (Patch v0.2.0), and #40 isn't on main yet. main's catalog.json has only the 111 Core entries, its patch history stops at v0.1.1, and the Classic and Classic+ cards exist only on the unmerged origin/v0.2.0 branch. Which should happen? (a) Merge #40 / v0.2.0 into main, then queue #44 again. (b) Fold these rarity and text changes into #40's branch before it merges. (c) Have the bot only update docs/classic-sets.md now. Whichever you choose, please also settle the family conflict the issue raises. Either the ___ Glowy Jelly Bean and ___ of the Forgotten families become Common, or Core #27 Blood Ridden, #28 Knockoff Temu and #40 Echoes of the Forgotten become Rare, which breaks the issue's 'Core: no changes'.

45.question: Issue #45 says not to start until #40 (Patch v0.2.0) ships, and it hasn't: main's newest patch is v0.1.1, its catalog has only Core (100 cards and 11 tokens), and R366 still uses "Cost (N)". Should the bot (a) wait and build #45 after #40 merges into main (recommended), or (b) do a Core-only text pass on main now with today's "Cost (N)" wording and leave Classic, Classic+ and the "(N) Cost" switch to a later patch?

46.question: Issue #46 says not to start until #40 (Patch v0.2.0) has shipped, and it hasn't: main (0e5800e) has only the Core set, and the v0.2.0 work is still on the unmerged origin/v0.2.0 branch (newest commit fb6a927). Should I (a) wait and re-queue #46 once v0.2.0 is merged into main, (b) build only the repo-side items now against Core-only main (move the session out of localStorage for S15, add a Terms page and an accessibility page for L04, enforce the CSP for W05, add server tests for G1–G6), and leave the Classic/Classic+ checks for later, or (c) split #46 into a repo-only code issue plus an owner checklist for everything that needs a person or a live service?
